refactorNotes: Definitions, behavioral assertions, capture call sites and module order are mapped to the immutable baseline. Hashes normalize CRLF and outer whitespace. Baseline scenario ranges first remove their enclosing try block four-space indentation, exactly as extraction did.

Explicit refactored functions migrate readiness, scoping, capture timing and process cleanup. Setup creates isolated fixtures; Test-DeviceRefresh rejects the normal user snapshot fallback. All other function bodies and scenarios remain byte-equivalent after normalization.
The shared-state top-level modules run at entry script scope in original order. These structural checks supplement, and never replace, disposable native evidence.
PeopleRooms is additional #284 coverage between Progress and Persistence; it preserves the relative order and assertions of every baseline scenario.

#302 adds Devices Refinements between Filters and Columns without changing the existing fixture or relative baseline order. It verifies exact Any/missing/unrestricted counts, exclusive selection, the assignment choice threshold, keyboard-opened usage evidence, a rendered final-column separator and fixed-width resizing. Test-RowDensity retains its original hashes/provenance, cases, assertions and captures; only UsageOnly's intended one-line height expectations change. The Interaction scenario's existing pixel/resize check now requires the final divider to be visible, following the user's explicit clarification; no capture or behavior case is removed.
